exercises.explanationUz:
MODUL 3 — 9 dan 12 gacha bo'lgan unitlar.

UNIT 11 — 'All's Well That Ends Well!'
  = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi yaxshi!
  Bu — Shekspir pyesasining nomi va ingliz maqoli.
  O'zbekcha muqobili: 'Oxiri xayr bo'lsin.'
  MAVZU: his-tuyg'ular va munosabatlar (feelings & reactions),
         favqulodda holatlar (emergencies)
  RASMLAR: mashinaga hujum qilayotgan sherlar (xavf);
           qo'rqqan va xursand odamlar (his-tuyg'ular)

UNIT 12 — 'See New Places, Meet New Faces!'
  = Yangi joylarni ko'ring, yangi odamlar bilan tanishing!
  MAVZU: shaharlar (towns & cities),
         transport turlari (means of transport)
  RASMLAR: zamonaviy katta shahar; eski somon tomli uy

points.en: Unit 11 — All's Well That Ends Well!
points.noteUz:
Shekspir pyesasining nomi va ingliz maqoli.

exercises.instructionUz: O'rganish maqsadlari va mashq qilinadigan grammatika.
exercises.explanationUz:
LEARN HOW TO ... (nima qilishni o'rganasiz):
  • give directions ........... yo'l ko'rsatmoq
  • ask for information ....... ma'lumot so'ramoq
  • ask personal questions .... shaxsiy savol bermoq
  • report emergencies ........ favqulodda holat haqida xabar bermoq
  • make comments ............. fikr bildirmoq
  • make suggestions .......... taklif kiritmoq

PRACTISE ... (qaysi grammatikani mashq qilasiz):
  • was/were – had – could
       O'TGAN ZAMON boshlanadi!
       was/were — 'be' ning o'tgan zamoni
       had — 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni
       could — 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni
  • past simple (regular – irregular verbs)
       o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar
  • prepositions of place/movement
       joy va harakat predloglari
  • adjectives/adverbs
       sifat va ravish
  • comparisons
       qiyoslash (bigger, the biggest)
  • quite/too/very/much
       daraja so'zlari

DIQQAT — MUHIM O'ZGARISH:
  1-8 unitlarda faqat HOZIRGI zamon o'rganilgan edi
  (Present Simple va Present Continuous).
  3-moduldan boshlab O'TGAN ZAMON kiritiladi.

points.noteUz:
'directions' = yo'l ko'rsatmalari.
'Turn left', 'Go straight on' kabi iboralar.

points.en: Learn how to ask for information
Learn how to ask personal questions

points.uz: Favqulodda holat haqida xabar berishni o'rganing
points.noteUz:
'to report' = xabar bermoq.
Yong'in, baxtsiz hodisa, kasallik.

'a comment' = fikr, izoh.
'make a comment' = fikr bildirmoq.

'a suggestion' = taklif.
'Let's ...', 'Why don't we ...?' kabi iboralar.

points.uz: was/were – had – could ni mashq qiling
points.noteUz:
O'TGAN ZAMON shakllari:
  am/is → WAS;  are → WERE
  have/has → HAD
  can → COULD

points.uz: O'tgan zamonni mashq qiling (to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar)
points.noteUz:
TO'G'RI fe'l: work → workED
NOTO'G'RI fe'l: go → WENT, see → SAW

points.uz: Joy va harakat predloglarini mashq qiling
points.noteUz:
JOY: in, on, under, next to
HARAKAT: into, out of, along, across, through

SIFAT otni tavsiflaydi: a QUICK car
RAVISH fe'lni tavsiflaydi: drive QUICKLY

big → biggER → the biggEST
good → better → the best

quite = ancha;  very = juda;
too = haddan tashqari;  much = ancha (qiyosda)
